status_note: DRAFT: not frozen. final_run.py refuses to run until status is FROZEN and --i-confirm-frozen is passed. Change status only after the author's explicit OK.
chosen_on: development data only: signals 2010-01-01 to 2015-12-31, data through 2016-03-31 (outputs/stage4_grid_results.csv, outputs/stage4_prediction_quality.csv)

target.definition: 90-calendar-day gross return: entry at the next session's adjusted close after the signal, exit at the first quoted adjusted close on or after entry + 90 days (exit delay at most 5 sessions, else missing)
target.training_transform: each signal date's cross-sectional percentile rank of the 90-day return, minus 0.5

extra_features_note: Set by the pre-registered GARP experiment (stage5_garp_experiment.py): empty = baseline only; if adopted, the 8 GARP-set columns, merged from data.extra_features_path on (date, symbol). Strategy parameters do not change either way.
confirmed_decisions: Author confirmed (Wed): long_gap_policy 'hold' with zero-recovery bound; annual refits; top 50, 2% total cap, entry every 5 sessions, 10 bps per side.

eligibility.universe: dated quarterly membership for the quarter of the next-session entry, plus 63 complete trailing daily returns (course_data apply_membership/price_features)
eligibility.positions_after_universe_exit: kept to normal maturity; membership is not a sell signal

clean_flag.max_abs_log_move_252_note: ln 5: exclude if any |daily log move| over the trailing 252 observed sessions exceeds ln 5
clean_flag.applied_to: training rows, scored rows and new purchases alike; held stocks are never altered (jumps are a diagnostic only)

model.estimator: Ridge inside course_data.make_pipeline (training-fitted 1/99% clipping, median imputation with indicators, scaling, sector one-hot)
model.retraining_note: refit at 2016-03-31, then at the first session of each calendar year; each fit uses only rows with label_end < fit date; scores apply from the fit date until the next fit
model.retraining_evidence: 2012-2015: rank IC once 0.0365 / annual 0.0341 / quarterly 0.0368; top-5% winsorized gap 0.69 / 0.88 / 0.75 pp; median grid CAGR 12.6% / 13.4% / 13.3%. Differences are small and inconsistent by year: weak evidence. Annual chosen because a single 2016 fit would never learn from 2016-2026 outcomes, and annual needs 11 fits instead of about 42.

strategy.type: ScoreStrategy: buy the top N clean eligible scores on each decision date
strategy.per_name_cap_note: cap on the TOTAL position in a name (held lots at last marks + new order), as a fraction of NAV at the decision close
strategy.cohort_fraction_rule: entry_every / sessions_per_hold = 5/63 of NAV per cohort, limited to cash at the decision close
strategy.selection_evidence: Grid of 8 (N {20,50} x cap {2%,5%} x every {5,21}) per retraining rule. N=50 beat N=20 in all 12 pairs; every 5 beat every 21 in all 12 pairs (partly from higher average investment, 92% vs 85%); cap 2% vs 5% nearly identical at N=50, so the tighter cap is kept. Annual N=50/2%/5: CAGR 15.3%, Sharpe 1.03, max DD -10.6% vs ^SP500TR 14.9%, 1.00, -12.0% (2012-2015). Best-of-8 on four years: expect some selection optimism.

backtest.fee_note: per side; entry fee inside the dollar budget: units = budget / (price * (1 + fee))
backtest.exit_rule: sell at the close of the first session on/after entry + 90 calendar days that has a quote
backtest.orders_funded_by: cash at the signal close only; next-day sale proceeds do not fund next-day buys
backtest.missing_entry_quote: reject the order, keep the cash
backtest.long_gap_policy_note: CONFIRMED by the author (Wed). 'hold' = a held stock with no quote for more than 5 sessions stays in NAV at its last mark, is never sold without a quote, and is reported with a zero-recovery bound (NAV with those positions at 0). It still counts toward the 2% per-name cap at its last mark.
backtest.jump_flag: record held stocks with |one-day log move| > ln 5; never alter prices
backtest.metrics: final value, CAGR (elapsed days / 365.25), max drawdown, Sharpe on daily returns (252 sessions)

dates.convention: initial-capital history row dated 2016-03-31; first fills and the benchmark purchase at the 2016-04-01 close; first model fitted only on outcomes ended before 2016-03-31; no order planned on the last session; open lots valued at the 2026-09-30 close
